daily_brief: On the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks, the United States commemorates victims with a new moment of silence honoring the 9,400 who have died from exposure-related illnesses [RFI, France 24, Le Monde]. The geopolitical landscape remains turbulent as Yemen's Houthis seized the strategic Red Sea port of Mokha and Perim Island in the Bab al-Mandab Strait, threatening global shipping routes and contributing to surging oil prices [BBC, Globe and Mail, France 24]. Russian forces struck a shopping center in Pavlohrad, Ukraine, killing five and wounding 67, while civilians in Donbas fortress cities are being urged to evacuate as fighting intensifies [BBC, The Economist]. President Putin arrived in India for an 11-member BRICS summit, with Chinese President Xi Jinping expected Saturday in his first India visit since 2019, signaling a cautious thaw between the nuclear-armed neighbors [RFI, ABC Australia]. In Hong Kong, three Tiananmen vigil organizers received sentences of up to seven years under the national security law, marking another erosion of the territory's civil liberties [BBC, Nikkei Asia]. Anthropic disclosed it blocked attempts to use its AI for biological weapons development and ballistic missile research, prompting renewed calls for AI regulation [BBC, Financial Times].

top_stories.headline: Houthis Capture Strategic Red Sea Port of Mokha, Threaten Key Global Shipping Lane
bullets: Iran-backed Houthi forces seized Yemen's Red Sea port city of Mokha and advanced to Perim Island in the Bab al-Mandab Strait, the southern gateway to the Suez Canal shipping route
Pro-government forces withdrew from positions as Saudi-led coalition conducted air strikes on Houthi-controlled areas; hundreds killed and thousands displaced in week-long offensive
Houthis stated Red Sea navigation remains safe for non-Saudi shipping; Saudi Arabia has relied on Red Sea exports since the Iran conflict effectively closed the Strait of Hormuz
Oil prices surged on concerns about disruption to one of the world's most important shipping corridors

top_stories.headline: US Marks 25th Anniversary of 9/11 With New Tribute to Toxic Exposure Victims
bullets: Official ceremony in New York adds seventh moment of silence honoring over 9,400 people who died from illnesses linked to Ground Zero toxic exposure
Federal medical monitoring program documented deaths among rescue workers and survivors exposed to contaminated air at attack sites
Anniversary prompts media reflection on legacy of War on Terror, with European and Middle Eastern outlets noting long-term consequences of subsequent conflicts
Senator Bernie Sanders renewed calls to pause advanced AI development, citing national security concerns

Ukrainian authorities ordered civilian evacuations from fortress cities Slovyansk and Kramatorsk as daily glide bomb attacks intensify
Russia controls nearly 80% of Donetsk region; forced evacuations of families with children have begun in worst-affected areas
Trump administration peace envoy talks in Moscow and Kyiv yielded few concrete results

top_stories.headline: Hong Kong Tiananmen Vigil Organizers Sentenced to Up to Seven Years Under Security Law
bullets: Lee Cheuk-yan sentenced to seven years, Chow Hang-tung to seven years and three months, Albert Ho to five years after pleading guilty
Convictions under national security law for inciting subversion of state power related to organizing annual June 4 commemorations
Hong Kong was the only place in Chinese territory where Tiananmen commemorations were permitted until 2020 ban
Defendants faced maximum of 10 years; sentences mark continued erosion of Hong Kong's political freedoms

top_stories.headline: Anthropic Blocks AI Misuse for Biological Weapons and Ballistic Missiles
bullets: Anthropic identified and disrupted attempts to use Claude AI model for activities supporting biological weapons development
Financial Times reported Houthi-linked actors attempted to use Anthropic AI to build ballistic missiles
Google separately disclosed attempted misuse of Gemini AI to obtain guides for synthesizing weaponized biological agents
Senator Bernie Sanders called for pause on advanced AI development; Trump rejected such concerns citing competitive pressures
